description: This file defines the CoreDataNoteRepository class which implements note data management using Core Data. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and fetching notes, as well as reconciling remote notes with local storage.

classes.name: CoreDataNoteRepository
classes.description: A class managing note persistence using Core Data, implementing methods for CRUD operations, synchronization, and querying.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content, saving it to Core Data asynchronously.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in Core Data based on its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted by setting its `isDeleted` flag to true asynchronously.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes matching an optional search query, sorted by most recent update.

methods.name: fetchDirtyNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes that have unsynchronized changes.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles a list of remote notes with local Core Data storage, applying last-write-wins logic.

methods.name: fetchEntity
methods.description: Helper method to fetch a NoteEntity by UUID within a given context.

methods.name: notesPredicate
methods.description: Static method to generate NSPredicate for filtering notes based on query and deletion status.
